notes: RBox contraction paired with finance-replace-0018: removes the revision's original property (has_iso_4217_code is functional: one alphabetic code per currency at a time), so every query expects 'does not know'. Instances are the revision's (sterling GBP, yen JPY); the second asks whether a second code could hold (could it: original no, open once removed), so the two instances differ in answer. The second values (PDS, YNJ) are not ISO codes. Near unrelated is the revision's (an ISIN identifies one security, which stays); far is the revision's. hops counts the prompt's premises as one bridge.
